foreground_boundary: GT object-ID transitions with at least one foreground side,5x5 dilation (2px);report only
large_occluder: GT foreground connected component>=1024px,then boundary/invalid excluded
depth_reference: fixed E1 explicit cluster depth at that pixel;C pixels outside explicit coverage separately flagged
depth_distribution: strongest actually composited hidden Gaussian,plus all-hidden optical-weight bin masses;no new RGB renders
SSE: per-pixel sum of squared display-RGB error to input;delta=with-hidden minus no-hidden;positive increase and signed net both reported
